items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: And we had in the band a wonderful trumpet player... his name was Andy Peretti

ctx.x: And while we were there, a set up of that band shell was across from the Frank Buck display; he was there, he was alive then, with some animals. And we had in the band a wonderful trumpet player, whom I know you worked with, just

a great lead trumpet player. He was with Tommy's band, his name was Andy Peretti, he was well known for his griping, he was an artist at griping, and he was also very beloved by all musicians as a great artist, and they sent Frank Buck over at one of our short intermissions; we were still sitting on the Bandstand, and he came over to get the crowds around and they used to advertise; they'd take times like this to advertise because they had a big crowd listening to our band. So Frank Buck came, however, with a…
And, he set the monkey on a chair and started to do his spiel about come on over and I'll explain and I'll show you some of our animals and explain some of my expeditions into Africa.
